acceptance_test: Orbit speed_med 0.45-0.6 H/s and owner confirms covers remain readable.
candidate_rule:
problem: The orbit can feel sluggish next to the reference tempo.
implementation: Raise the cruise angular velocity or orbit axis tilt until median screen speed reaches 0.45-0.6 H/s, then check readability at 0.5x.
use_when: Orbit phases under 2 s.
avoid_when: Covers must be readable individually during the orbit.
cause_hypothesis: [reference-interpretation; unvalidated] Global angular velocity of ~1 rad/s around a vertical axis moves front/back covers in opposite directions, lowering median screen speed.
problem_evidence: Orbit screen speed 0.23-0.31 frame heights/s vs reference 0.62.
